description: List collections in a library. scope="all" returns every collection flat (each carrying its parentCollection key, so the full tree can be reconstructed in one call), "top" returns only root-level collections, and "children" returns the direct subcollections of parentKey. Collection keys returned here are what zotero_create_items, zotero_add_items_to_collection and zotero_search_items take.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-500).

parentKey.description: Parent collection key; required when scope is "children".

scope.description: Which collections to return. "children" requires parentKey.

start.description: Zero-based offset for paging; pass the nextStart value from a previous call.

verbose.description: Return Zotero's raw API envelope (library block, self/alternate links, full meta) instead of the flattened object. Costs many extra tokens per object; only useful when a URL or the raw meta block is genuinely needed.

name: zotero_list_collections
title: List collections
